title: Analyze synthetic service requests
objective: Calculate request-weighted latency and failure rate from the synthetic daily aggregates; return a reproducible analysis.
audience: Technical operator and local implementation agents
context: Sanitized demonstration fixture. No actual client data, production repository or account state is represented.

frozen: Preserve the stated scope and output IDs.
Clearly distinguish performed work from suggested steps.
exclusions: Do not use Work or Codex
implementation_freedom: Choose concise explanatory wording unless exact text is supplied.

authorization.approval_basis: Synthetic/public example content authored for this release; approval applies only to these fixture bytes.

questions: What is the total failure rate?
Which day has the highest failure rate?

data_dictionary.mean_latency_ms: daily mean in milliseconds, weighted by requests

payload.coverage: Six complete synthetic days, 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-06. No production representativeness is claimed.
payload.missing_values: No nulls expected; fail validation if any occur.
payload.method: Weighted means and exact ratio of sums. Do not average daily failure percentages unweighted.
payload.reconciliation: Requests must sum to 700; failures must sum to 17. Check independently.

acceptance: Label gaps, assumptions and tests not run.
